verdict.rationale: Warp syncs data through Warp Drive and runs cloud agents, so data residency is a fair question for it. However, the evidence documents no way to pick a storage region or residency. The nearby privacy features are related but different controls: Zero Data Retention, no storage of terminal input/output, telemetry opt-out, and cloud agents running on your own infrastructure. None of these is a region or residency choice, so they earn no credit.
